verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs say it manages SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA and PCI-DSS in one place with "pre-mapped controls", and it exposes framework-health APIs. That implies a shared control set across frameworks, but no evidence explicitly says SOC 2 work automatically counts toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of cross-framework control and evidence mapping, any view showing the overlap between frameworks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
